question: Fenil starts from Point Y and drives 19 km towards the west. He then takes a left turn, drives 49 km, turns left and drives 12 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 28 km. He takes a left turn and drives 38 km. He then turns right and drives 21 km to stop at Point Z. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point Y again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
**Given: **

Fenil starts from Point Y and drives 19 km towards the west.

He then takes a left turn, drives 49 km, turns left and drives 12 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 28 km.

He takes a left turn and drives 38 km.

He then turns right and drives 21 km to stop at Point Z. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45e6648b7747ac70a007960f471a28a2635a3b4ec036a45acdc491c21179d4b0.png] 

Thus, he should drive 45 km towards the east in order to reach Point Y again.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
